We are seeking a highly collaborative and detail-oriented Business Analyst to work alongside a US-based client BA on the Vision product. This role will partner directly with stakeholders, product teams, and software engineers to transform business needs into well-defined product requirements, leveraging modern AI-assisted and Specification-Driven Development practices.
We are seeking a highly collaborative and detail-oriented Business Analyst to work alongside a US-based client BA on the Vision product.
This role will partner directly with stakeholders, product teams, and software engineers to transform business needs into well-defined product requirements, leveraging modern AI-assisted and Specification-Driven Development practices.
The ideal candidate is comfortable working directly with clients, asking the right questions to uncover business needs, and translating high-level ideas into actionable specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria that enable efficient software delivery.
Key Responsibilities
  • Collaborate closely with a US-based Business Analyst and client stakeholders to define and refine product requirements.
  • Facilitate remote, client-facing discussions to gather business needs, clarify objectives, and document requirements.
  • Elicit requirements through effective questioning, active listening, and stakeholder interviews.
  • Transform loosely defined business requests into structured product specifications, including:
  • Epics
  • Features
  • User Stories
  • Acceptance Criteria
  • Business Rules
  • Partner with development teams to ensure requirements are clearly understood and effectively implemented.
  • Support backlog refinement, sprint planning, and requirement clarification activities.
  • Create and maintain product documentation using Specification-Driven Development practices.
  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate requirement gathering, analysis, documentation, and refinement activities.
  • Review and validate delivered functionality against documented requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring alignment throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Outstanding questioning and discovery skills.
  • Ability to uncover underlying business problems rather than simply documenting requests.
  • Comfort challenging assumptions and driving clarity.
  • Strong attention to detail while maintaining a product-oriented mindset.
  • Passion for leveraging AI and modern development practices to improve delivery quality and speed.

Nice-to-have

  • Experience working in AI-enabled software development environments, including Specification-Driven Development (Spec-Driven Development), where requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria are leveraged as the primary source of truth for software delivery.
